uefa.champions.name: Champions League

markets.label: Top 8
markets.note: Top 8 skip the playoff and go straight to the last 16.

markets.label: Playoff (9-24)
markets.note: Places 9 to 24 play off for the last 16. This middle band is the hardest to call: in testing the model did no better than a flat guess here.

uefa.champions.pending: Chances to win the trophy will be shown after the knockout draw. They depend on who is drawn against whom, which is not known yet.
